home.tagline: Here you see what is coming up next.

tenant.choose: Please open the app via your department's link.
tenant.noAccess: You have no access to this department.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

login.intro: Enter your e-mail address. You will get a link to log in without a password.
login.sent: If the address belongs to a member, a login link is on its way. Please check your inbox (and spam folder).
login.inviteOnly: New here? You become a member via your team's invitation link.

join.invalid: This invitation link is invalid or expired.
join.profileIfMissing: We only need name and gender if you have no profile in this department yet.
join.childIntro: Your child gets an own profile. You decide what it may do in the app by itself.
join.emailHint: We will send you a link to confirm the address.
join.acceptTerms: Joining means the <terms>terms</terms> apply; how we handle your data is described in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

team.addPersonHint: E.g. for a child: create the profile, then invite the parents by link on the profile page.
team.addFromDepartmentHint: Take people who are already in the department (e.g. from another team) into the team – they appear right away, no invitation needed.
team.playsHigher: Plays in {{team}} – trains here, but no match days
team.addMeHint: Do you play in or coach this team yourself?

settings.idealSquadHint: How many players per position does the team want? E.g. mixed without libero and opposite, but more outside hitters. Empty = any, 0 = none. Used as template for the Positions-Soll and as the measure when guests may only accept for missing positions.

profile.standardHint: All members of the department see these details.
profile.detailsHint: Only you, parents, your coaches and admins see these – others only what you share below.
profile.sharingHint: What is switched on here, all members of the department can see.
profile.devicesHint: Logged in as {{email}}. The login stays active for 90 days after the last use.
profile.deleteAccountProfiles: Your profile is deleted in all clubs, with replies, tasks and votes.
profile.deleteAccountChildren: Your children’s profiles stay in the club, but you no longer have access to them.
profile.deleteAccountKept: Chat messages and cash bookings stay without your name.
profile.deleteAccountConfirm: Type your e-mail address to confirm ({{email}})
profile.marketingLabel: I want to receive news and offers about VolleyOrga by e-mail
profile.marketingHint: Voluntary and revocable here at any time – without it you only get e-mails that belong to using the app (login links, notifications). See <terms>terms § 8</terms> and <privacy>privacy</privacy>.

child.title: What may the child do by itself?
child.hint: Only parents can change this. Everything else you do for your child.

personLinks.title: Access by link
personLinks.hint: Single-use link, valid for 14 days. Pass it on via messenger or e-mail.

members.inviteHint: For further admins or helpers without a team. All admins have the same rights – including removing admins and deleting data. Players are best invited with the team's invitation link.
members.inviteAsAdmin: Invite as admin (link for 1 person, 14 days)

calendar.title: Calendar subscription
calendar.hint: Add this secret address as a subscription in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook – your events (and your children's) then appear there automatically.
calendar.resetConfirm: The previous address will stop working. Continue?

notices.title: Heading
notices.toHint: Afterwards the info disappears automatically, at most one year.
notices.notifyHint: Goes to everybody the info is for, as soon as it is visible – by push or e-mail according to their settings.
notices.notifyOff: No notification – the info only appears on the start page.

events.title: Title
events.allTeams: For all teams of the department
events.repeatUntilHint: empty = ongoing (about 6 months are always created ahead)
events.addressHint: Used for the “Start directions” button (Google Maps).
events.helperHint: E.g. club party or home match day. Add the tasks (e.g. till, sales) below under “Tasks” – or later in the event. Helpers sign up there.
events.positionLimitsHint: At most this many acceptances per position (empty = no limit). Who finds no place on the main position counts for a free secondary one.
events.positionLimitsInfo: When a position is full, accepting for it is closed; declining frees the place again.
events.minParticipantsHint: Optional – empty = value from the team settings. Below it the training is marked yellow; once the number can no longer be reached, red with “Training does not take place”.
events.guestsAllowedHint: Cross-nominated players from other teams; the same reply deadline applies as for everybody.
events.guestsPositionsOnlyHint: Cross-nominated players can only accept if their position still has a place in the Positions-Soll – without one the team’s ideal squad counts.
events.guestsPositionsOnlyInfo: Guests can only accept on missing positions.
events.idealSquadInfo: Guests can only accept as long as their position has a place here.
events.correctHint: Ticked = was there (preset with the acceptances). Replies can be changed afterwards, too – both count for the statistics.
events.attendanceNotRecorded: Attendance not recorded yet – until then an acceptance counts as present.
events.enterForPlayers: With ✓ ? ✕ you enter a player’s reply directly, e.g. after talking to them.
events.cancelText: Everybody invited gets a message. The event stays visible as “cancelled”, replies are kept. You can undo the cancellation.
events.deleteText: The event disappears with all replies and tasks. If it is still ahead, everybody invited gets a cancellation message. This cannot be undone.
events.deleteSeriesHint: Only this date is deleted – the series continues.
events.endSeriesText: What should happen to the upcoming dates of this series? Past dates stay for the statistics.
events.droppedText: After this change these dates no longer belong to the series (e.g. because it now ends earlier). Should they be cancelled or deleted?
events.minimumReached: Training takes place – minimum of {{min}} reached
events.minimumPossible: at most {{possible}} of the {{min}} needed replies still possible

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.deviceOn: Push messages are on for this device.
notifications.deviceOff: Push messages are off for this device.
notifications.iosInstall: On iPhone and iPad push messages only work when the app is on the home screen: tap “Share” in Safari, then “Add to Home Screen”. Open the app from there and turn them on here.
notifications.iosTooOld: Push messages need iOS 16.4 or later.
notifications.unsupported: This browser does not support push messages. E-mails still arrive.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Please allow them in the browser or system settings.
notifications.failed: Push could not be turned on. Please try again later.
notifications.hint: Applies to this department. Push arrives on every device where you turned it on.

categories.reminder: Reminder if you have not replied yet

leagues.title: League tree
leagues.hint: The level (1 = top division) ranks the teams. It decides who can invite whom by cross-nomination and that players of a higher team cannot play in a lower one.
leagues.name: Name
leagues.levelHint: Empty = same as the parent league.

referee.title: Referee license
referee.expiresSoon: Expires soon – please renew in time.

guests.hint: Cross-nomination: invite players of lower teams to your trainings for good. They see the trainings on their start page and can accept from the set time while places are free.
guests.noLeague: Cross-nomination needs a league for the team (admins set it in the settings).
guests.title: Guests
guests.noCandidates: No matching players in lower teams.

groups.hint: Training groups are parts of the team with their own trainings (e.g. setter training). Trainers and organizers are always invited.
groups.name: Name
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete group “{{name}}”? Its trainings become trainings of the whole team.

teamBase.title: Team & league
teamBase.hint: Rank: order when several own teams play in the same league (1 = highest).

stats.empty: No past events with replies in this period.
stats.onlyTrainers: Only trainers and admins see the rates – players see their own.
stats.explain: Rate = accepted divided by events the person was invited to (cancelled events do not count). Tap to see the single events.
stats.tasksNone: No tasks taken in this period.
stats.pageHint: Acceptance rates and tasks taken are shown per team. Trainers see all players, players only themselves.
stats.noReactionHint: Events in the period that were not answered at all.

import.title: Import schedule – {{team}}
import.hint: Upload a calendar file (.ics/.ical) or the CSV schedule from SAMS. You first see a preview and choose which matches to take over. Later you can import the updated file again – changed matches are updated instead of added twice.
import.ownName: The team’s name in the file
import.ownNameHint: Decides home/away and which matches belong to the team. Remembered for the next import.
import.skipped_one: {{count}} entry concerns other teams and is ignored.
import.skipped_other: {{count}} entries concern other teams and are ignored.
import.missingHint: These imported matches are missing from the new file. They are not cancelled automatically – please check.

status.cancelled: cancelled in the app – left as is

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.mineNone: You have not taken any tasks right now.
tasks.helpWantedNone: No helper services with free places right now.
tasks.templateName: Name of the template (e.g. “Match day women 1”):
tasks.templateHint: The template’s tasks are created with the event and can be adjusted afterwards.
tasks.templateForSeries: The tasks are created for every event of the series – also for those created later.

templates.title: Task templates
templates.hint: Fixed task lists, e.g. for home match days (cash desk, sales, line judges, scoring). Take them over when creating an event or here into several events at once.
templates.none: No templates yet. Tip: tap “Save tasks as template” at an event with tasks.
templates.deleteConfirm: Delete template “{{name}}”? Events keep their tasks.
templates.name: Name
templates.slotsHint: Number of people optional – empty means any number.

tasks.byHandHint: E.g. “Referee duty 1st match”, “Till”, “Cake”. Number of people optional – empty means any number. Players and parents sign up in the event afterwards; you can add more tasks there at any time.

polls.allowFreeText: Allow an own answer as text
polls.resultsAfterVote: You see the result once you have voted.
polls.deleteConfirm: Delete the poll with all votes?
polls.question: Question

notify.emailWithoutPush: Only to those who get no push
notify.hint: Push goes to everybody who switched on push on a device. Whoever has no push still gets an e-mail this way.

remind.title: Notify participants
remind.onlyOpen: Only to those who have not voted yet

cash.hint: Team cash books and the department's cash book – no real payments. Bookings are not changed but cancelled if necessary.
cash.none: You do not keep a cash book. Team cash books are kept by trainers, organizers and admins.
cash.cancelConfirm: Cancel booking “{{description}}”? It stays visible but no longer counts.
cash.openingHint: Balance before the first booking, e.g. from the previous cash book.

halls.hint: Halls, available times, contacts and which team trains when. Only admins can change it.
halls.hintAdmin: Add halls with their available times and assign the teams. Overlaps are marked but not prevented.
halls.outsideSlots: Outside the hall's available times or parts
halls.deleteConfirm: Delete hall “{{name}}” with all times and bookings?
halls.name: Name
halls.contactHint: E.g. caretaker or booking office – visible to all members.
halls.slotCourtHint: Which parts are available to us? Nothing chosen = whole hall (e.g. part 3 is used by another sport).
halls.openingHoursHint: Like opening hours: when is the hall available for training every week? Several times per day with +. Match days and other events are not affected.

closure.mode: Events in the hall during this period
closure.modeCancel: Cancel – stay visible as “cancelled”, replies are kept
closure.modeDelete: Delete – disappear with replies and tasks
closure.seriesHint: Training series create no dates in this period (delete) or only cancelled ones (cancel). Invitees get one message for the whole closure.
closure.affectedHint: Events whose place is this hall (name or address). Trainings are preselected, match days and other events only if you tick them.
closure.none: No events in this hall during the period.
closure.liftConfirm: Lift the closure? Cancelled events stay cancelled; training series create deleted days again.

privacy.title: Personal data
privacy.exportHint: Everything stored about this person as a file (JSON): profile, teams, replies, tasks, votes, cash bookings, own chat messages.
privacy.deleteHint: The profile is deleted for good with teams, replies, tasks, votes, licence and picture. Cash bookings stay without the name. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteOwnHint: Your profile is deleted for good with teams, replies, tasks, votes, licence and picture, and you lose access to this department. Chat messages stay without your name, cash bookings without reference to you. This cannot be undone.

start.tagline: Team organisation for volleyball departments – events, replies, chat, cash and more.
start.noClub: You are not in a club yet. Ask your trainer for an invitation link.
start.loginIntro: Log in with your e-mail address. You will get a link that takes you to your club.
start.registerHint: Your club does not use VolleyOrga yet?

register.title: Register club
register.intro: Register your club's volleyball department. After our approval you get an e-mail as admin and add your teams.
register.slugHint: Your address: {{url}} – only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
register.youHint: You manage the club in the app and invite trainers and players.
register.accept: I am entitled to register this club's volleyball department and agree to the storage of the data.
register.acceptTerms: I am authorised to register this club’s volleyball department and accept the <terms>terms including data processing</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

platform.title: Platform administration
platform.hint: Approve new clubs, suspend or reactivate clubs. The clubs' contents are not visible here.
platform.rejectConfirm: Reject and delete the registration of “{{name}}”?
platform.suspendConfirm: Suspend “{{name}}”? Nobody from the club can log in then; the data is kept.
platform.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” with all data for good? Type the short name “{{slug}}” to confirm:

accounts.hint: All accounts of the platform. Accounts unused for more than 2 years automatically get an e-mail and are deleted 14 days later (except the only admin of a club).
accounts.deleteConfirm: Delete account {{email}} with all profile data in all clubs? Type the e-mail address to confirm:

legal.title: Details for imprint, privacy policy and terms
legal.hint: These details appear in the imprint, the privacy policy and the terms. Required: name, address and e-mail.
legal.disclaimer: The texts are a careful template, but no legal advice. Best have them checked by an expert before going live.

platform.noAccess: You are logged in as {{email}}. This account has no access to the platform administration – you need the operator account for that.
platform.switchAccount: Log out and log in with another account
platform.loginFirst: Please log in on the start page with the operator account first.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.hint: What was created, changed or deleted in the last 7 days – older entries are removed automatically. Admins only.
activity.none: No changes in the last 7 days.

rules.title: Answer several events
rules.link: Answer several events (e.g. always on Wednesdays)
rules.intro: Accept or decline many events at once, e.g. “Wednesday trainings: yes, Friday: no”. Applies to all upcoming matching events and automatically to new ones. You can still answer single events differently at any time.
rules.reasonHint: Entered as reason for every event (some teams require one).
rules.deleteHint: Removing ends the standing reply for new events; answers already entered stay.
rules.noPersons: Your account has no profile you can answer for.

documents.intro: Documents for the whole club (e.g. the club registration) and for single teams (e.g. set-up instructions for match days). You see the documents of your teams.
documents.fileHint: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, LibreOffice, pictures, videos, text – up to {{mb}} MB.
documents.folderHint: Optional, e.g. “Match day” or “Association” – the same folders are grouped.
documents.visibleAll: Visible for all members of the club.
documents.visibleTeam: Visible only for this team (players, parents, trainers, organizers) and admins.

legal.germanOnly: The legal texts are only binding in German.
legal.incomplete: The operator details have not been entered completely yet.

install.title: VolleyOrga as an app
install.text: Install VolleyOrga on your phone – with its own icon on the home screen and push notifications.
install.iosStep1: In Safari tap “Share” at the bottom

theme.title: Appearance
theme.hint: “Auto” follows your device setting. Applies to this device only.
